description: This file defines the SecurityFactory class which provides a mechanism to obtain Security instances, primarily via Java's ServiceLoader, and includes an inner class OFBizSecurity that implements the Security interface with methods related to authorization, permission checks, and security group management within the Apache OFBiz framework.

classes.name: SecurityFactory
classes.description: A factory class for obtaining Security instances, supporting pluggable implementations via Java's ServiceLoader. It contains an inner class OFBizSecurity implementing core security functionalities tied to the OFBiz entity engine.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns a Security instance for a given Delegator, loading implementations via ServiceLoader or defaulting to OFBizSecurity.
